newsitem.title: USA: Southern National to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Southern National to buy back shares.

text.p: Southern National Corp said Tuesday its board of directors approved a plan to repurchase up to five million shares of its common stock.
Southern National said it had another plan, approved in April 1995 and amended in September 1996, to buy back up to five million shares of its common stock.
By the end of 1996, it said it had bought about 3.8 million shares.
"The 1.2 million shares remaining under this plan and the five million newly authorized shares provide Southern National with the potential of repurchasing up to 6.2 million shares," it said.
In the fourth quarter ended December 31, the company had 111.3 million shares.
